# Instant Message Address

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:InstantMessageAddress`](gmeow-InstantMessageAddress.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/InstantMessageAddress>
- **Category:** class

A contact point reachable through an instant-messaging or chat service — a handle, channel, or service-scheme URI (xmpp:, weixin:, matrix:, …).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a channel reached through an instant-messaging or chat service — a handle, room, or scheme URI (xmpp:, matrix:, weixin:) — when the contact point is neither email, telephone, nor postal.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for an email-style address (use [`gmeow:EmailAddress`](gmeow-EmailAddress.md)) or a telephone-bound messenger identified by number (use [`gmeow:TelephoneNumber`](gmeow-TelephoneNumber.md)); avoid storing the owning account here — that is [`gmeow:OnlineAccount`](gmeow-OnlineAccount.md) in the accounts slice.

### How to use

- Type the handle as [`gmeow:InstantMessageAddress`](gmeow-InstantMessageAddress.md), link it to its owner with [`gmeow:hasContactPoint`](../properties/gmeow-hasContactPoint.md), and carry [`gmeow:hasSensitivity`](../properties/gmeow-hasSensitivity.md) so a public projection can withhold or coarsen it; record the service via [`gmeow:contactPointProvider`](../properties/gmeow-contactPointProvider.md) when the platform matters.

### Examples

- ex:lillithMatrix a [`gmeow:InstantMessageAddress`](gmeow-InstantMessageAddress.md); [`gmeow:hasSensitivity`](../properties/gmeow-hasSensitivity.md) [`gmeow:sensitivitySensitivePersonal`](../individuals/gmeow-sensitivitySensitivePersonal.md).
